title: Select and authorize the initial managed-cloud deployment target

assigned_to.reason: Blueprint leaves provider selection open and this decision changes residency, KMS, IAM, browser-worker isolation, and deployment evidence.

exact_question: Choose the smallest reversible US managed-cloud target and record an ADR covering cost, compliance, workload identity, managed Postgres/KMS/object storage, private networking, audit logs, region, and browser-worker isolation.
safe_boundary: Do not enable production deployment or claim a cloud-specific integration until the ADR and current official service evidence exist.
unblock_condition: Approved ADR plus current provider documentation and provisioning evidence are added to PREFLIGHT.md and DECISIONS.md.
release_impact: Blocks deployment-specific proof and GO; does not block cloud-neutral blueprint work.
